Khinkali, khachapuri and souvlaki

Food

What comes to the table

From what guests write in their Google reviews.

Khinkali

Georgian dumplings, boiled or pan fried. 10 reviews mention them.

Khachapuri

The Georgian cheese pie, cut into wedges. Guests also mention piroshki with potato.

Shashlik and souvlaki

Shashlik, lamb kebab, chicken and pork souvlaki, sheftalia and kontosouvli from the grill.

Generous portions

Guests write about big portions and fair prices. 5 reviews mention the generous portions.

From the grill and the oven

Photos from the Google listing.

How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

Live music on Fridays

Several guests write about the music nights with live music every Friday.

Fresh and authentic

A Georgian guest calls the food truly authentic, just like back home. 6 reviews mention the fresh ingredients.

Room for celebrations

A spacious outdoor patio, and inside a room for birthdays, christenings and parties.

On Aglantzias Avenue

At Leoforos Aglantzias 20 in Nicosia. Open in the evening from 17:00, closed on Mondays.

What guests say

Three of 220 Google reviews, 202 of them with five stars.

“Amazing food and service. Delicious khinkali, khachapuri, sashlik (souvlaki) and piroghki (pies) with potato made with love. Highly recommended to visit. Portions are big and true value for money!”

Google review
“Love this place: lamb kebab and chicken souvlaki are incredibly good. Don't miss a chance to taste the delicious khachapuri.”

Google review
“Excellent food. Not much variety but that is a good thing. They focus on few items and they prepare them well. Large portions too.”
